photos.title: File:16.09.97 Hillerød Type EMUs (33096018456).jpg
photos.author: Phil Richards from London, UK
photos.description:
Type MC 4-car EMUs built for København S-Bane services seen at Hillerød on 16 September 1997. 

Only 12 sets were built, 4 as prototypes from different manufacturers in 1979 and a small batch of 8 sets from 1986. Never much of a success, these had all gone by 2006.
